connector.name: BidSparq
connector.registryDescription: 55 tools for federal/state/local RFPs, awards, vendors, contact graph, contract vehicles, pursuits.
connector.summary: Hosted at bidsparq.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package bidsparq-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.bidsparq, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: BIDSPARQ_API_KEY

env.name: BIDSPARQ_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the API base URL (defaults to https://bidsparq.com)
